architecture.name: Masked positive logit pool
architecture.inputs: six frozen KEEP binary margins, availability mask, legal session indicator
architecture.pool: exp(theta_j) positive weights normalized over available experts
architecture.output: learned global positive scale times pooled logit plus bias

training_protocol.inner_calibration: one disjoint subject fold per outer fold
training_protocol.loss: binary cross-entropy plus L2 on log-weights

benchmark_adaptation.WBCIC_development: best observed model is raw L2 linear stacking; CI crosses zero and it is not authorized for outer evaluation

outer_block_reason: direct transfer is negative and WBCIC adapted gain has a subject-bootstrap CI crossing zero
